title: malva spinosa
intro: Malva spinosa, commonly known as the prickly mallow or Scottish mallow, is a perennial plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is native to parts of Europe and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. Malva spinosa's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its medicinal properties, including its ability to calm digestive issues and support wound healing.
